name: What are common reasons a water heater thermostat stops working?

mainEntity.name: What are common reasons a water heater thermostat stops working?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water heater thermostats can stop working due to several common reasons, including electrical surges, sediment buildup interfering with the sensor, general wear and tear from age, or faulty wiring. Occasionally, a tripping high-limit switch, designed as a safety feature, can be mistakenly identified as a thermostat failure. A professional inspection by CG Plumbing Solutions can accurately determine the specific cause and ensure the correct repair is performed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common reasons for thermostat failure include electrical surges, sediment buildup, age-related wear, faulty wiring, or a tripped high-limit switch.
